findings.evidence: TotalRamification.lean:114 `variable (hK : finrank ℚ K = 2) (hp : p.Prime) (hmem : p ∈ ramifiedPrimes K)` gates all of that file's public theorems, and its module doc (line 37) has to compensate in prose: "In the namespace `NumberField`, all for `Module.finrank ℚ K = 2`". Quadratic/Basic.lean:56 `theorem finrank_rat_eq_two (hmin : minpoly ℤ θ = X ^ 2 - C d) (hgen : Algebra.adjoin ℚ {(θ : K)} = ⊤) : finrank ℚ K = 2`. Mathlib has no `NumberField.Quadratic` namespace, so it is free.
findings.fix: Put the `Quadratic/` files in `namespace NumberField.Quadratic` (still canonical-rooted, no `TauCeti` prefix) and update in-repo call sites; alternatively give each name a `quadratic` component.
findings.issue: The whole quadratic-presentation slice is moved into the root `NumberField` namespace, so hypothesis-gated quadratic facts now carry canonical names that read as general number-field statements: `NumberField.finrank_rat_eq_two`, `minpoly_rat_quadratic`, `coe_gen_sq`, `coe_gen_sq_ratCast`, `gen_notMem_range`, `not_isSquare_radicand`, `trace_gen_eq_zero`, `discr_one_gen`, `discr_one_halfGen` (Quadratic/Basic.lean:43); `halfGen`, `coe_halfGen`, `adjoin_gen_eq_top_of_mod_four_ne_one`, `adjoin_halfGen_eq_top_of_mod_four_eq_one`, `discr_eq_four_mul_of_mod_four_ne_one`, `discr_eq_of_squarefree_of_mod_four_eq_one` (Quadratic/RingOfIntegers.lean:43); `primesOver_eq_singleton_of_mem_ramifiedPrimes`, `ncard_primesOver_eq_one_of_mem_ramifiedPrimes`, `ramificationIdx_eq_two_of_mem_ramifiedPrimes`, `inertiaDeg_eq_one_of_mem_ramifiedPrimes`, `map_span_eq_sq_of_mem_ramifiedPrimes`, `map_eq_self_of_mem_ramifiedPrimes`, `mem_ramifiedPrimes_iff_ramificationIdx_eq_two` (Quadratic/TotalRamification.lean:55); `classGroupMk0_sq_eq_one_of_mem_ramifiedPrimes` (Quadratic/RamifiedPrimesClassGroup.lean:38). `NumberField.mem_ramifiedPrimes_iff_ramificationIdx_eq_two` is outright false as its canonical name reads (a ramified prime of a cubic field can have e = 3); every consumer that does `open NumberField` now sees `halfGen`, `discr_one_gen`, `finrank_rat_eq_two` with no marker of the θ-presentation they require.

findings.evidence: PrimeDivisibility.lean:25 `theorem not_intCast_prime_dvd_natPrime {p l : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (hl : l.Prime) (hne : p ≠ l) : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ (l : ℤ)`; WorkedExamples.lean:64 `namespace NumberField.WorkedExamples`; both helpers have cross-file consumers (RadicandSplitting.lean:49, Discriminant/Basic.lean:166) so `private` is not available.
findings.fix: Keep these repo-local (`TauCeti.…`, as `TauCeti.Multiquadratic` was kept — neither `Internal` nor `WorkedExamples` names a mathematical object upstream), or promote each helper under its true canonical home (`Int`/`Nat` for `not_intCast_prime_dvd_natPrime`).
findings.issue: Scaffolding namespaces are moved into the canonical namespace: `NumberField.Internal` (PrimeDivisibility.lean:22, Internal/QuadraticIntegralBasis.lean:26) and `NumberField.WorkedExamples` (EffectiveBounds/WorkedExamples.lean:64). `NumberField.Internal.not_intCast_prime_dvd_natPrime` is a statement purely about ℕ/ℤ primes with no number field in sight, yet is now advertised as canonical `NumberField` API; `NumberField.WorkedExamples.classNumber_adjoinRoot_sqrt_neg_five_le` (a non-sharp `≤ 320` bound for one model of ℚ(√-5)) is repo-local demonstration material presented as canonical API.

summary: The move to the canonical namespace is right for the genuinely general results, but it also plants quadratic-field-only lemmas (one of them false for general number fields) at the top of Mathlib's `NumberField` namespace, and plants two non-mathematical scaffolding namespaces (`Internal`, `WorkedExamples`) there as well. Nest the quadratic slice under `NumberField.Quadratic` and keep the scaffolding out of the canonical namespace.
